name: CKEditor5 highlight
description: Adds a CKEditor 5 highlight (marker/pen) toolbar button using the upstream @ckeditor/ckeditor5-highlight plugin. DEPRECATED in favour of ckeditor5_plugin_pack.
project_description:
This module adds highlight feature to CKEditor 5.

 The highlight feature offers text marking tools that help content authors speed up their work, for example when reviewing content or marking it for future reference. It uses inline elements in the view, supports both markers (background color) and pens (text color), and comes with a flexible configuration.
